notes: 0.3.45：修掉 0.3.44 里「工作区与会话跟机器走」实际不生效的两个问题。① apply.ps1 第 4 步只按会话目录映射判断要不要跑，仓库里只有 session_projcache、没有 sessions 数据时整段被跳过，projcache 的 cwd 从未被改写；现在 projcache 有活也会跑。② fix-session-cwd.mjs 用「改动前后长度相等」当成「内容没变」，两台机器路径长度一样时（D:\DeepSeekHarness ↔ E:\DeepSeekHarness）必然误判，文件里的 cwd 仍指源机而结果报「本就正确」；现在按内容判等。两处在隔离环境（两台假机 + 本地裸库）从零跑通 A 推 B 拉的全链路时抓出来，修后 projFixed=1、拉取完成 cwd 正确指向本机。README 同步重写并精简，新增「从零开始：让第二台机器跑起来」与实测记录。
notesEn: 0.3.45: fixes two reasons the 0.3.44 "workspaces and sessions follow the machine" feature did not actually work. (1) Step 4 of apply.ps1 only checked the session directory map, so when the repo carried session_projcache but no sessions data the whole block was skipped and the projcache cwd was never rewritten; it now also runs when there is projcache work. (2) fix-session-cwd.mjs treated "the rebuilt text has the same length as the original" as "nothing changed", so two machines with equally long paths (D:\DeepSeekHarness vs E:\DeepSeekHarness) always misjudged: the file kept the source machine cwd while the result reported "already correct"; it now compares content. Both were found by a from-scratch run in an isolated environment (two fake clients + a local bare repo) covering push on A and pull on B; after the fix projFixed=1 and the cwd points at the local machine. The README was rewritten and trimmed, with a new "From scratch: bring up the second machine" section and the test log.
